breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains the contradictory 'gamma-centered' language in the SCF step: 'Use the same k-point grid specification (8x8x4 Monkhorst-Pack with half-shift, gamma-centered) as in Step 1.' A half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid (shift = 1 1 1) is by definition not gamma-centered. The ground truth resolves this by removing the gamma-centered instruction entirely and keeping only the half-shift specification. The agent failed to fully eliminate this inconsistency.
